column1: # Old Wix page addresses and the page each one now answers with, as a 301 (Alex approved 2026-10-12).
# Built from hs-seo-data/puppyconnection/2026-10-10/technical/proposed-page-map.tsv. The rows that map left as
# decisions take its recommended defaults. build/generate.mjs appends these after the per-puppy lines and
# stops the build if a target page is missing. {portal} is the portal origin. A trailing * matches the rest.

# The old breeder addresses are mislabeled (copy-of-breeder-perry is titled Cozy Pine Canine), so each breeder row goes by the title the old page shows, checked 2026-10-28. The rows still to /breeders.html wait on Amber saying which kennel each page was.
